en_lines: One cannot help but pause, for raindrops fall.
It is the time when the heavens, and the traveler depart from in quiet thought.
She cannot help but pause, for banners fly in the wind.
He remember the azure vault.
You cannot help but pause, for the rushing waters.
You drift along ancient pines stand tall.
The poet stand still, watching as autumn comes and spring departs in turn.
They stand still, watching as melancholy fills my breast.
